# omada_port_profiles (Data Source)

Lists switch port profiles for a site on the Omada controller.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Uses the provider's default site unless site or site_id is given.
data "omada_port_profiles" "all" {}

# Look up a profile the controller created for a VLAN network, by name.
locals {
  iot_profile_id = [for p in data.omada_port_profiles.all.profiles : p.id if p.name == "IoT"][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name to query (resolved to an ID). Ignored if `site_id` is set.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID to query. Provide this or `site`; if neither is set, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `profiles` (Attributes List) The port profiles defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The profile ID.
- `name` (String) The profile name.
- `native_network_id` (String) The untagged (native) network ID, empty for a profile with none.
- `origin` (String) Who owns the profile: `builtin` (All, Default and Disable, which cannot be deleted), `network` (created by the controller along with a VLAN network, carrying it untagged, and deleted with it), `user` (created in the UI or through this provider), or `unknown`.
